intervals.label: completed
intervals.note: The paper says the proton-decay experiment stopped data taking in 1993; it does not give a separate retirement date for this detector.
intervals.quote: Since the management of KGF mines decided to start closing the mines in 1993, the proton decay experiment stopped data taking in 1993.

placements.note: Placed at the Kolar Gold Fields site; the mine level and shaft are not given by any source consulted (the depth is in the specs).
placements.quote: This detector became operational in 1985. The Phase II detector comprised of about 4000 proportional counters and total weight of 260 tons.

depth.note: Paper unit hg/cm^2; 1 hg/cm^2 = 1 m.w.e. The page text of the second figure reads 'installed at a 2 depth of 6045 hg/cm' because the superscript is displaced.
depth.quote: installed at a 2 depth of 6045 hg/cm (Ref. 10)

total_mass.quote: This detector became operational in 1985. The Phase II detector comprised of about 4000 proportional counters and total weight of 260 tons.

summary.plain: A larger second proton-decay detector at KGF, about 260 tons, operating from 1985 at a slightly shallower level than the first.
summary.technical: Phase II: about 4000 proportional counters (6 m long) in 60 layers with 0.6 cm iron plates, 6 x 6 m^2 floor area, 260 t, at 6045 hg/cm^2.

technology.quote: The Phase II detector was also of similar type but used only 6 m long proportional counters.
technology.value: Iron-walled proportional counters in crossed horizontal layers interleaved with iron plates
